title: Anchor Buddy app quality plan
scope: Improve current app UX/UI and finish existing application behavior. Planning only; no task implementation is authorized by this document alone.

tasks.title: Unify visual hierarchy and semantic colors
tasks.evidence: theme.ts exposes only two typography styles; green is blue and orange is gray. Screens repeat small text sizes and status styles. This is a consistency opportunity, not evidence that every screen fails contrast.
tasks.scope: Define semantic action, information, warning, error and neutral tokens plus a small text/spacing scale. Migrate shared primitives first; leave individual screen adoption to their tasks.
accept: Document normal, compact and large-text examples with before/after captures.
Unknown, excluded and passing statuses remain distinguishable through labels/icons as well as color.
Core text/control contrast is measured; no assessment status or calculation changes.
tasks.verify: Run mobile typecheck; inspect shared controls at 390 and 1280 CSS px and 200% text. No snapshot-only unit tests.
tasks.review: Standard review; domain/watch wording review where named in acceptance.

tasks.title: Finish shared controls and keyboard selection
tasks.evidence: Shared buttons/chips lack consistent explicit minimum hit areas. SelectField is an expanding button list without complete keyboard selection behavior. The browser accessibility snapshot includes decorative icon glyphs in control names.
tasks.scope: Give controls visible focus and predictable disabled/pressed states, hide decorative icons from accessible names, enlarge small targets, and implement one coherent keyboard pattern for SelectField.
accept: Interactive hit areas reach 44×44 CSS px or equivalent without overlapping neighbors.
Keyboard can open, choose and cancel a select; selection remains visible and focus returns predictably.
Accessible names contain meaningful text without icon glyphs; selected/disabled state is announced.
Tour step controls remain compact visually while being comfortably tappable.
tasks.verify: Mobile typecheck plus keyboard/screen-reader smoke on mounted controls. Add only interaction tests for the selection behavior.
tasks.review: Standard review; domain/watch wording review where named in acceptance.

tasks.title: Connect validation errors to their fields
tasks.evidence: Field supports help and required state but has no error/invalid prop or focus handle. Forms flatten validation messages into a notice at the bottom.
tasks.scope: Add optional error, invalid state and focus support to Field, with a small mapping from existing validation paths to field labels. Search and vessel tasks consume this API.
accept: Error text is associated with the input and announced together with label/unit/help.
Required, disabled, zero and empty values retain their existing meanings.
Form owners can focus the first invalid field without querying internal DOM structure.
Unrecognized domain errors remain visible in a form-level summary rather than being dropped.
tasks.verify: Mobile typecheck and one mounted invalid-field check; test only nontrivial error-path mapping. Do not change domain validation.
tasks.review: Standard review; domain/watch wording review where named in acceptance.

tasks.title: Make sheets preserve focus and unsaved work
tasks.evidence: Sheet closes directly on close/back and has no action footer or dirty-state interface. React Native Modal may already provide some focus behavior; verify it before adding a replacement.
tasks.scope: Add opt-in footer, pending and dirty-close policies for editable forms. Verify dialog naming, initial focus, background isolation, Escape/back and focus restoration using the existing Modal.
accept: Untouched forms close immediately; dirty forms offer Keep editing and Discard.
Save/close actions remain reachable with the software keyboard or a short viewport.
Pending commit cannot be accidentally dismissed; failed commit retains editable input.
Informational sheets retain their simple close behavior and focus returns to their trigger.
tasks.verify: Mounted web keyboard flow, 390×844 and short-height checks; record native keyboard behavior separately once a build is available.
tasks.review: Independent review of changed state, contracts and failure handling.

tasks.title: Polish the responsive app shell and notices
tasks.evidence: App.tsx uses a fixed-height header and a single 960px breakpoint. Empty Explore exposes inactive filters before a search. Its global message is one dismiss button, making content/status semantics weak. Current 390px Explore had no document overflow.
tasks.scope: Adapt header/navigation and Explore empty-state hierarchy to narrow screens and large text. Give global notices readable content and a separate dismiss action with appropriate status semantics.
accept: At 320/390/768/1280 widths, title, watch entry and tabs remain reachable with no document overflow.
Empty Explore emphasizes starting/opening a search and downloading a map; inactive controls do not dominate.
Notice text is announced once and remains readable independently of its dismiss control.
Navigation and closing a search preserve independently verified active watch status.
tasks.verify: Before/after captures at stated widths, 200% text and keyboard checks; mobile typecheck. Keep controller transitions unchanged.
tasks.review: Standard review; domain/watch wording review where named in acceptance.

tasks.title: Add a repeatable browser journey harness
tasks.evidence: The mobile test command runs library and service-worker tests. Browser journeys in docs/validation are manual; no mounted end-to-end suite currently runs.
tasks.scope: Add a small browser harness and one documented local command with isolated storage, server lifecycle cleanup and failure artifacts. Cover initial setup, empty Explore, search submit/cancel, save/close/reopen and the browser watch boundary.
accept: Tests run without internet or real provider availability using test-runner-only interception/fixtures.
Production bundles, runtime entry points and API behavior gain no fixture toggle or synthetic fallback.
Unexpected page errors fail the run; failures capture a useful screenshot and control context.
Suite starts/stops only its own servers and leaves existing user browser data untouched.
tasks.verify: Run the new command twice from isolated contexts and npm run check:runtime. Keep positive nautical fixtures behind existing test-only boundaries.
tasks.review: Independent review of changed state, contracts and failure handling.

tasks.title: Use exact conversions consistently
tasks.evidence: CANONICAL_CONVERSIONS already defines the policy, while Forms and units use rounded 1.15078/3.28084-style constants.
tasks.scope: Reuse frozen exact conversion constants across inputs and display; preserve the existing untouched-draft behavior and canonical stored quantities.
accept: Repeated nautical/metric/imperial toggles preserve untouched values within the frozen tolerance.
An edited display value is converted exactly once when committed; zero bow height stays zero.
Search radius, wind, vessel dimensions and map-download units match their labels.
No safety limit, rounding policy for assessment, or domain contract changes.
tasks.verify: Extend units/formDrafts/mapDownloadControls tests for boundary and round-trip cases; run domain/mobile tests and typechecks. Numerical diff needs independent review.
tasks.review: Independent review of changed state, contracts and failure handling.

tasks.title: Commit vessel and default saves before closing
tasks.evidence: App.tsx saveVessel/saveDefaults mutate state before unawaited persist; persist catches failures. Forms calls void onSave and closes immediately.
tasks.scope: Return explicit asynchronous save outcomes, commit before publishing active values, and keep the draft open during pending/failure. Add a reusable persistence command boundary without redoing the workspace controller. Before changing writers, freeze one authoritative settings key/envelope, commit-result API and legacy-read/migration ownership, consistent with docs/contracts/v2.md. Q09–Q11 must consume that interface; do not introduce competing migrations.
accept: A failed write preserves previous committed/active values and all edited form input.
Pending save prevents duplicate commits; success closes once and survives reload.
Retry commits the intended draft once and clears the local error.
Equipment changes still invalidate guidance/plans only at the correct committed transition and never stop an active watch.
The handoff names the authoritative persistence interface and legacy compatibility policy used by preference, startup and setup tasks.
tasks.verify: Inject rejected/delayed writes; test retry and reload. Run mobile library tests/typecheck and a mounted form flow. Reviewer inspects state/publication order.
tasks.review: Independent review of changed state, contracts and failure handling.

tasks.title: Serialize preference changes and report failures
tasks.evidence: savePreferences publishes units/offline/layers and launches an unawaited save. Rapid combined changes and failures have no explicit per-action lifecycle.
tasks.scope: Serialize or supersede preference writes so the latest combined intent wins. Show pending/failure/retry adjacent to the changed preference and use explicit rollback or retained-unsaved state.
accept: Rapid unit/layer/offline changes reload as the latest combined selection.
An older write cannot overwrite a newer acknowledged choice.
Write failure is visible beside its control with Retry or rollback, not a silent success.
Changing display units does not change vessel/search physical values or native watch configuration.
tasks.verify: Controlled delayed/reordered/rejected write tests and Settings reload smoke; mobile tests/typecheck.
tasks.review: Independent review of changed state, contracts and failure handling.

tasks.title: Recover readable data after partial startup failure
tasks.evidence: Startup reads through one Promise.all; a rejected read can prevent applying otherwise valid data. Malformed JSON is returned as null, indistinguishable from an absent record.
tasks.scope: Represent missing, corrupt and temporarily unreadable records distinctly; hydrate valid categories independently and offer targeted retry/recovery. Preserve current storage identifiers and versioned contracts.
accept: A corrupt optional cache cannot hide a valid vessel or saved-search library.
Recovery identifies the affected category and never silently overwrites recoverable records as a new installation.
Unknown schema versions remain preserved and visibly unsupported; migration does not relabel data as verified.
Native watch verification remains independent and reachable during startup recovery.
tasks.verify: Fault-injection cases for one rejection, malformed JSON, unknown version and mixed valid records; reload/retry smoke. Independent review required for migration/deletion behavior.
tasks.review: Independent review of changed state, contracts and failure handling.

tasks.title: Finish setup as one durable configuration
tasks.evidence: finishSetup writes vessel, defaults, preferences, profile confirmation and setup completion separately. A partial write can leave inconsistent completion state.
tasks.scope: Use the existing versioned persistence contract to commit/recover setup coherently. Make completed-step summaries and the next required action clear without pre-filling vessel facts.
accept: Failure at each write boundary cannot expose completed setup with incomplete committed inputs.
Restart resumes valid progress; retry is idempotent and preserves entered vessel values.
The final Continue action becomes successful only after durable completion.
Review initial setup can return to Settings and cannot obstruct a running watch.
tasks.verify: Inject interruption before/during completion and reload; cover first setup and reopened setup. Review migration compatibility before merging.
tasks.review: Independent review of changed state, contracts and failure handling.

tasks.title: Make vessel configuration easier to complete
tasks.evidence: ProfileSheet presents all vessel and equipment inputs in a long sheet and reports validation only at the bottom. Required actual values and optional air draft already exist.
tasks.scope: Group vessel dimensions and anchoring equipment with concise explanations, inline errors and a clear save footer. Preserve required factual inputs and existing equipment invalidation.
accept: Invalid submission focuses the first invalid field and preserves other edits.
Optional fields are clearly distinguished; all required inputs remain reachable at 390px and large text.
The form shows selected units and concise completion guidance without inventing equipment ratings.
Save pending/failure/discard behavior uses the shared form contract.
tasks.verify: Before/after phone/desktop captures plus invalid→correct→save/reload journey; mobile typecheck.
tasks.review: Standard review; domain/watch wording review where named in acceptance.

tasks.title: Organize search into area stay and limits
tasks.evidence: SearchSheet contains location/map/coordinates, dates, seabeds and many operating inputs in one scrolling form. The mounted defaults form exposes the full sequence before Save.
tasks.scope: Put area and stay first, group depth/seabed and operating limits, and add concise current-value summaries for collapsed sections. Wire inline errors and an accessible primary footer.
accept: New search and Search defaults retain their different semantics and actions.
Current safety/operating values remain discoverable; collapsing a section never resets or silently changes values.
Validation expands/focuses the offending section and does not close the form.
Multi-seabed selection, custom centre and cancellation preserve existing behavior.
tasks.verify: Mounted new/default/edit flows at phone width with invalid radius and multiple seabeds; existing formDrafts tests and typecheck.
tasks.review: Standard review; domain/watch wording review where named in acceptance.

tasks.title: Clarify stay timezones and calendar interaction
tasks.evidence: The calendar has hard-coded single-letter weekday headers and no explicit day-grid keyboard pattern. Existing helpers handle skipped/repeated local hours; this capability should be preserved.
tasks.scope: Show the timezone actually used for entry and the resulting stay/contingency summary. Add accessible calendar navigation and full weekday/date announcements without silently changing the time basis.
accept: Device timezone and selected-area timezone differences are explicit wherever they affect interpretation.
Keyboard can traverse days/months and cancel; selected day and repeated-hour choice are announced.
Existing DST gap/overlap validation remains explicit and overnight duration is preserved.
Stay versus contingency end is understandable; UTC persistence remains unchanged.
tasks.verify: Existing localDateHour tests plus keyboard calendar journey and two timezone/DST examples; do not redesign timezone conversion without review.
tasks.review: Independent review of changed state, contracts and failure handling.

tasks.title: Make submitted search progress and completion truthful
tasks.evidence: Location lookup has loading/no-results handling but no explicit local cancellation. openSaved announces reassessment before asynchronous search-data work completes.
tasks.scope: Add explicit lookup cancellation and useful offline/no-match/provider-failure feedback; announce reassessment completion only for the active finished request. Reuse existing request generations.
accept: Queries are sent only on explicit submit or Enter; no autocomplete/network-on-keystroke.
Changed query, cancellation or newer search prevents old matches/success messages from replacing current intent.
Reassessment starts as pending; final message distinguishes fresh, cached, partial and failed evidence.
Long match names wrap and selected area stays clear; no fabricated fallback places.
tasks.verify: Delayed, cancelled, empty, offline and provider-failure cases using controlled transport; mounted search/reopen flow and controller tests.
tasks.review: Independent review of changed state, contracts and failure handling.

tasks.title: Recover map loading and renderer errors
tasks.evidence: Chart.web sets a generic warning for map errors and never clears it. Chart.tsx has no equivalent explicit loading/failure presentation.
tasks.scope: Model initial loading, partial tile/source failure, renderer failure and recovered state. Offer retry or list fallback; use confirmed cached-map readiness when explaining offline display.
accept: A transient error clears only after an appropriate successful recovery signal.
Partial tiles and a failed renderer have different helpful messages.
Retry does not lose selected place, chosen pin or map area.
Phone overlays remain clear of attribution and controls; native behavior is verified on available builds or marked pending.
tasks.verify: Inject map/source events, inspect online→failure→recovery and offline-cache behavior. Web mounted check; native check after Q36/Q37.
tasks.review: Independent review of changed state, contracts and failure handling.

tasks.title: Keep map markers ranks and selection consistent
tasks.evidence: Both chart implementations independently take the first 50 results and assign rank by array position. Selection styling replaces status color, and the selected map card loses status context.
tasks.scope: Derive a shared display model for rank/status/selection and make the first-50 boundary explicit. Preserve status when selected and keep manual pins separate.
accept: Filtering/sorting produces identical visible rank and selected identity in map/list.
Selecting a list item beyond the marker limit either reveals it explicitly or explains its absence; it never highlights another place.
Selected markers retain human-readable status; manual pins are not added to source-result counts.
A compact legend explains marker/selection symbols without implying nautical coverage.
tasks.verify: Deterministic cases with >50 results, filter/sort changes, removed selection and manual pin; mounted map/list check plus native later.
tasks.review: Independent review of changed state, contracts and failure handling.

tasks.title: Improve result card scanning and status language
tasks.evidence: Cards use very small status text and raw a.status in accessible labels; they do not surface a concise leading evidence/exclusion reason.
tasks.scope: Use a consistent hierarchy for name/type, assessment status, distance/depth/cost and one leading reason. Translate internal statuses into clear display language.
accept: Unknown depth/price is visibly different from zero depth or free.
Excluded and insufficient evidence are distinguishable without relying on color.
Accessible name communicates place and status naturally, without internal enum/glyph noise.
Long names and large text wrap without hiding the open-details action.
tasks.verify: Visual matrix using existing test-only assessments with long names, unknowns and each status; phone/desktop and screen-reader smoke. No calculation changes.
tasks.review: Standard review; domain/watch wording review where named in acceptance.

tasks.title: Explain filters and empty result states
tasks.evidence: Applied filters are mostly summarized inside Advanced filters. Different empty result situations share generic No matching results wording.
tasks.scope: Show a compact summary distinguishing result filters from search/seabed preferences. Add a Reset result filters action for result-only state; preserve the existing Advanced Reset → All seabeds/no preference → Apply/reassess behavior with explicit wording. Use existing data/request state to distinguish no search, loading, unavailable provider, no source places and filters hiding results.
accept: Each empty state gives an appropriate action such as start, retry or reset.
Reset result filters preserves search/seabed/operating inputs. Advanced Reset explicitly clears seabed preference and reassesses on Apply as today; neither action relaxes safety thresholds.
Counts agree between map/list and exclude manually inspected pins.
Advanced filter state and summaries stay synchronized when editing or reopening a saved search.
tasks.verify: Mounted matrix for each empty state and combined filters; workspace tests for reset semantics and typecheck.
tasks.review: Standard review; domain/watch wording review where named in acceptance.

tasks.title: Group details around evidence and next actions
tasks.evidence: Details renders reasons as a flat list and places its planning action after long weather/cost/source content. Existing source attribution and evidence gaps must remain available.
tasks.scope: Add a decision summary and group exclusions, missing evidence, available facts and provenance with progressive disclosure. Keep plan eligibility and the next action clear near the summary.
accept: All original reasons remain accessible; blocking reasons are visible before the plan action.
Display context, cached evidence and reviewed analysis use distinct language.
Source identity, retrieval/expiry dates and applicable limits remain inspectable.
No new positive safety wording, coverage inference or eligibility change is introduced.
tasks.verify: Review excluded/insufficient/passing test-only examples, long source lists and missing fields. Domain-aware reviewer checks wording; phone/desktop captures and typecheck.
tasks.review: Standard review; domain/watch wording review where named in acceptance.

tasks.title: Summarize forecast coverage for the whole stay
tasks.evidence: Details initially shows 12 weather intervals and RegionalDataSheet 24, with expansion already supported. Neither gives a concise stay/contingency coverage overview.
tasks.scope: Add an interval-derived summary using an immutable stay presentation prop from the exact search used to assess the detail/plan: arrival, departure, contingency end and displayed timezone. Wire it through App.tsx; never infer stay bounds from forecast rows or a different active search. Area previews with no stay show available forecast range only. Preserve full interval inspection and official warnings.
accept: Summary labels its timezone and distinguishes stay from contingency.
Worst available wind/gust/wave/current values exclude nulls and never imply complete coverage when gaps exist.
Centre-point weather context is not promoted into full-footprint assessment evidence.
All intervals and source dates remain accessible; missing/expired intervals are explicit.
The summary follows the selected detail/plan search even when it differs from activeSearch; a no-stay area preview makes no stay-coverage claim.
tasks.verify: Pure presentation-helper tests for gaps, overlap, nulls, expiry and unit systems; mounted details check. Reviewer verifies that coverage labels follow existing contracts.
tasks.review: Independent review of changed state, contracts and failure handling.

tasks.title: Render prices without invented currency or precision
tasks.evidence: money defaults absent currency to USD and limits fractional digits to two. Current CostEstimate carries currency/status/totals but no source precision metadata; minorUnitDigits exists only in a separate unwired tariff contract.
tasks.scope: Centralize formatting for legacy CostEstimate. For a valid known currency, use Intl.NumberFormat's currency default minor-unit precision (JPY 0, USD 2, KWD 3); document this as a display fallback, not source precision. Pass fee status where available; missing status is unknown, not proof of Free. Handle missing/malformed currency explicitly. Do not change tariff arithmetic, recover digits already rounded away, or wire SAFE-03.
accept: Missing currency never silently renders as USD; malformed currency does not crash.
JPY/USD/KWD display 0/2/3 fractional digits under the documented legacy policy; this does not claim to reconstruct source precision.
Zero is called Free only when the existing estimate state supports that conclusion.
Cards, details and saved snapshots render the same known estimate consistently; legacy snapshots lacking fee status do not call an unverified zero Free.
tasks.verify: Formatting tests for null currency, invalid code, zero/unknown status, JPY and KWD; domain/mobile typechecks and relevant tests. Reviewer approves formatting policy before coding.
tasks.review: Independent review of changed state, contracts and failure handling.

tasks.title: Make anchor-plan editing and arrival checks clearer
tasks.evidence: Planner combines coordinates, GPS capture, deployed rode, evidence and arrival confirmations in one screen; invalidation and unknown footprint behavior already exist.
tasks.scope: Group placement, rode/footprint and arrival checks in an explicit sequence. Keep the current chosen point/units visible and make map-pick/capture/cancel status unambiguous.
accept: Edited coordinates and rode remain clear while moving between map and fields.
Unknown swing footprint or scope is explained without drawing an invented validated circle.
Invalid entries focus their field; choosing/cancelling a point cannot silently move a confirmed anchor.
Watch handoff explains what must be physically confirmed and never arms automatically.
tasks.verify: Mounted manual/map/cancel/edit-search journeys and existing coordinate tests; native GPS check where available. Preserve assessment engine behavior.
tasks.review: Standard review; domain/watch wording review where named in acceptance.

tasks.title: Save anchor-plan drafts and reassess on return
files: packages/domain/src/compatibility.ts (new shared helper, if none exists)
tasks.evidence: Planner coordinates/rode/arrival checks live in local component state; controller plan state is transient. Old APP-06 remains unfinished.
tasks.scope: Implement explicit Save draft and a Saved entry using LocalRecord<SavedPlanPayload>. This task takes bounded ownership of the shared canonical compatibility fingerprint helper from unfinished SAFE-02: follow the fixed named-key/canonical JSON/SHA-256 specification in docs/contracts/v2.md, with unimplemented optional equipment identifiers explicitly null. The integrator reviews the projection and updates helper ownership before coding; do not add equipment registry/ratings or a competing scheme. Restore intended inputs only and recompute with current vessel/evidence.
accept: Reload preserves named draft coordinates, canonical rode, search/stay, explicit 0/20/30 depth allowance, vessel identity/fingerprint and exact source-pack references; failed save retains edits.
Reopening requires date review for elapsed stays and reassesses current evidence/profile.
Arrival confirmations and watch arming/monitoring state are never restored from a draft.
Unsupported/corrupt draft versions are handled without deleting other saved assets; deletion uses the common lifecycle.

Canonical fingerprint vectors are stable across key ordering/unit display/name changes and change for relevant canonical vessel inputs; source/version or vessel changes produce a material-change notice.
tasks.verify: Save→reload→open→reassess with changed vessel, expired dates and unavailable data; migration/failure tests. Schema and watch-boundary review required before implementation.
tasks.review: Independent review of changed state, contracts and failure handling.

tasks.title: Make the saved library limits and history explicit
tasks.evidence: App.tsx and readSavedSearches silently cap searches at 30. Saved already has collection headings/counts, saved-at/stay/vessel metadata, historical notices and empty actions; preserve these delivered controls.
tasks.scope: Keep the existing bounded capacity, but require an explicit replace/delete decision before a new save would discard a snapshot. Make replacement preview, cancellation and outcome clear. Verify existing historical labels, long names and collection metadata; change them only where the at-capacity flow exposes a demonstrated ambiguity.
accept: Saving item 31 cannot silently remove an existing named snapshot.
Historical evidence and expired stay are labelled; Open & reassess remains distinct from inspection.
Existing headings/counts, metadata and category-specific empty actions remain usable; no redundant library redesign or new sorting/search feature.
Legacy valid records are preserved; names wrap and snapshot dates are unambiguous.
tasks.verify: At-capacity save/cancel/replace regression and reload; mounted empty/mixed/long-name library. No cloud sync or new account system.
tasks.review: Independent review of changed state, contracts and failure handling.

tasks.title: Keep deletion pending until it succeeds
tasks.evidence: SavedScreen invokes void deletion callbacks and dismisses immediately. Map deletion removes assets before metadata writes; a late failure can leave partial deletion, so retaining the card alone is not rollback.
tasks.scope: Define deletion outcomes as complete, unchanged failure or partial cleanup pending. Await commands for searches/maps/evidence/drafts, reconcile metadata and asset availability after failure, and make retries idempotent. Do not promise rollback of removed assets; prevent opening a partially removed resource as if intact.
accept: Dialog names the exact resource and blocks duplicate delete submissions.
Failure before mutation retains the item and dialog. Partial failure displays cleanup pending/unavailable with retry, and reload does not falsely present the resource as intact.
Success removes only the chosen resource and restores sensible focus.
Active/unverified watch evidence protections are preserved and refusal stays visible.
tasks.verify: Inject failure before removal, after some assets, and before/after metadata persistence; retry and reload each state. Verify delayed/successful/protected deletes and keyboard focus. Storage reviewer checks partial-state reconciliation.
tasks.review: Independent review of changed state, contracts and failure handling.

tasks.title: Show map-download stages and usable progress
tasks.evidence: Download UI exposes phase strings and tile counts among dense instructions. Coarse-first partial usability, pause/resume and optional evidence already exist.
tasks.scope: Present preparation, map assets/tiles and optional evidence as distinct stages with truthful progress, pause/resume controls and clear completion actions.
accept: Percentages appear only when a denominator is known; progress announcements are throttled.
Partial map can be opened only when required coarse tiles/fonts are actually ready.
Complete map plus failed evidence is shown as two outcomes, not total success or total failure.
Pause/resume and updated-copy actions keep existing engine integrity and source attribution.
tasks.verify: Mounted prepare→partial→pause→resume→complete and evidence-failure scenarios using controlled downloads; existing download tests/typecheck.
tasks.review: Standard review; domain/watch wording review where named in acceptance.

tasks.title: Expose storage usage and protect retained evidence
tasks.evidence: Saved displays individual map sizes without total storage context. regionalDataCore retains eight cache entries, and the UI does not clearly distinguish automatically cached from deliberately retained evidence.
tasks.scope: Show known map/data usage and browser capacity where available. Define explicit automatic-versus-retained behavior and offer targeted delete/retry for quota failures; reuse existing storage contracts. Introduce explicit retention metadata through a reviewed migration. Existing savedAt is also set by discovery and cannot prove explicit retention; preserve ambiguous legacy entries as protected legacy records until the user chooses, rather than automatically evicting them.
accept: A new live search cannot silently evict evidence explicitly saved by the user.
Unknown native/browser capacity is labelled unknown; estimates are not guarantees.
Quota failure retains existing data and provides a useful manage-storage/retry action.
Retention changes never refresh source expiry or delete saved maps automatically.
Legacy entries are not classified as explicitly saved solely from savedAt, and ambiguous prior data is preserved until an explicit retention decision.
tasks.verify: Eight-plus-region retention and quota failure/retry tests; verify byte totals without double-counting shared assets. Persistence policy review before schema changes.
tasks.review: Independent review of changed state, contracts and failure handling.

tasks.title: Cancel reviewed-pack operations safely
tasks.evidence: Settings catalogue/download operations use shared busy/message state and timeouts without a user cancellation or lifecycle identity. The installer already stages and verifies content.
tasks.scope: Add cancellation and request ownership through catalogue retrieval, staging, verification and the last pre-commit guard. Define the durable active-pointer commit as the cancellation boundary: once commit begins, disable Cancel and settle/read its authoritative result even if the view unmounts. Clean only unreferenced staged assets; do not redesign verification/publication.
accept: Cancellation accepted before commit prevents activation and stale UI success. Unmount during commit cannot interrupt a successful durable write or claim cancellation.
Previous active pack survives pre-commit cancellation/failure; cleanup never deletes assets referenced by a committed active pointer, including after an uncertain response.
Watch replacement protection is rechecked immediately before activation.
Retry starts a coherent operation and cannot activate an obsolete response.
tasks.verify: Cancel during manifest, transfer, verification and immediately before commit; separately unmount during commit and simulate uncertain completion. Read back active-pointer state before cleanup, run installer fault tests and mounted Settings smoke. Independent activation-boundary review.
tasks.review: Independent review of changed state, contracts and failure handling.

tasks.title: Make connectivity and evidence freshness visible
tasks.evidence: Connectivity fallback and refresh logic exist, but offline preference, actual connection loss, retained evidence and expiry are explained in different places.
tasks.scope: Present a compact current state for connection, offline preference, data retrieval and freshness, with a contextual retry/refresh action. Reuse current refresh/cooldown rules.
accept: Intentional offline planning differs from detected disconnection and provider outage.
Expired/partial retained evidence keeps original dates during reconnect or failure.
An active refresh does not obscure the current available data or imply completion.
Retry respects offline preference/cooldown and cannot replace a newer search.
tasks.verify: Online→offline→reconnect, preferred-offline and expired/partial evidence scenarios; connectivity/controller tests and mounted smoke.
tasks.review: Standard review; domain/watch wording review where named in acceptance.

tasks.title: Expose offline app readiness and waiting updates
tasks.evidence: prepareOfflineShell registers/verifies the exported shell during download preparation but exposes no readiness/update state to the UI. Updates deliberately wait for prior tabs to close.
tasks.scope: Expose read-only shell lifecycle status plus retry and accurate update guidance. Keep Metro unsupported and preserve verified activation behavior.
accept: Shell ready/not-ready/error is separate from map/evidence availability.
A waiting update explains close/reopen behavior without forcing reload or skipWaiting.
Failed update keeps the previous complete shell usable and data intact.
Native/Metro surfaces do not claim browser service-worker readiness.
tasks.verify: Exported-build tests for first install, offline reload, waiting version and failed integrity update; scripts/web-offline.test.mjs. Reviewer checks worker lifecycle changes.
tasks.review: Independent review of changed state, contracts and failure handling.

tasks.title: Organize Settings and localize action feedback
tasks.evidence: Settings mixes everyday preferences with technical connection/provider controls. A shared message is rendered at the bottom, away from connection and pack actions.
tasks.scope: Keep everyday boat/display/offline controls easy to find; use clear progressive disclosure for data connection/source details. Place pending/success/failure beside its initiating action.
accept: API connection errors explain endpoint reachability and a retry using current platform context.
Connection, catalogue and download feedback cannot overwrite one another misleadingly.
Success/error announcements use appropriate semantics without repeated chatter.
Unavailable English translations and AI capability stay truthful; no fake account/sign-in flow.
tasks.verify: Phone/desktop settings journey with failed then successful endpoint/catalogue operations and keyboard navigation; typecheck. Preserve the stored endpoint/security rules.
tasks.review: Standard review; domain/watch wording review where named in acceptance.

tasks.title: Validate and cancel watch position capture
tasks.evidence: WatchScreen capture lacks the finite/range/future-time checks and request cancellation already present in PlannerScreen.
tasks.scope: Reuse or extract planner-quality validation and lifecycle guarding with caller-specific coordinate bounds: map/planner latitude remains ±85°, watch WGS84 latitude remains ±90°, longitude ±180°. Add explicit Cancel and prevent delayed capture from replacing newer manual/map input.
accept: Nonfinite/out-of-range coordinates, negative/nonfinite accuracy, stale and excessively future fixes are rejected.
Cancel, unmount, a new request or manual edit invalidates the older result.
Manual entry remains available and fixed-anchor semantics are preserved.
Only accepted current coordinates reach watch setup; an existing monitoring session is never recentered.
Shared validation preserves the different map and watch latitude bounds instead of silently narrowing valid watch coordinates.
tasks.verify: Focused fix-validation and delayed-request tests plus mounted capture state flow; native acquisition on available builds. Independent watch review required.
tasks.review: Independent review of changed state, contracts and failure handling.

tasks.title: Keep watch readiness aligned with native checks
tasks.evidence: WatchScreen stores tested as a permanent boolean; Swift and Kotlin reject audible tests older than 600000 ms. Permission readiness is summarized as a boolean despite platform-specific requirements.
tasks.scope: Show a concise readiness checklist with links to missing actions.
